mapper.update: UPDATE task_instance SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}
UPDATE task_instance SET end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_instance WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM task_instance WHERE status = 1 AND start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_instance WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBefore} DAY) AND status IN (2, 3, 4, 5)
